answer: Tundra-crystal summit admission: a new identity sits frozen 14 days in the tundra, a holding zone where anyone may challenge it. During the freeze the applicant publishes a crystal record, a log of one real completed task, signed by two unrelated clients staking $30 each, plus a $30 bond. Only if no challenge survives and both stakes verify does a summit panel of three rotating reviewers admit it. Forging 1,000 puppets costs $90,000 plus 1,000 distinct tasks and 2,000 clients, with no bulk discount and challenged stakes slashed; an honest user locks $90 once and reclaims it on admission.
